summary: Iteration 42 - P0 Driver Management Testing. All 19 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified Drivers tab with all features working. Fixed 2 bugs: route order for /drivers/vehicle-types endpoint and missing Input import in Layout.jsx.

issues: React warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent (inline provider modal)

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: /drivers/vehicle-types route was being matched by /drivers/{driver_id} - moved route definition before parameterized route
Fixed: Layout.jsx was missing Input component import causing runtime error
seed_data_creation: None - used existing 19 drivers from historical data
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 Driver Management fully tested. Drivers tab in Settings shows 19 drivers with search, provider filter, status filter. Edit modal has read-only fields (name, ID, first upload, total routes) and editable fields (provider select + inline create, vehicle type, status). Inline provider creation works via nested dialog. Layout page blocking modal for pending providers is triggered when route-summary upload returns pending_providers array (tested via backend API).

tests: GET /api/drivers/:id - Get driver detail with provider_name
GET /api/drivers/vehicle-types - Returns base types (moto, van, camioneta, auto)
POST /api/providers/inline - Returns existing if name matches (already_existed: true)

Table columns: Driver Name, Proveedor (Team), Vehiculo, Estado, Rutas, Acciones

Edit modal shows read-only fields (name, ID, first upload, total routes)
Edit modal shows editable fields (provider select, vehicle select, status select)

Layout page loads correctly (after Input import fix)
Step indicators visible (1. History Orders, 2. Route Summary, 3. Configurar)
Route Summary zone disabled until step 1 complete

bugs_fixed.root_cause: Route /drivers/vehicle-types was defined AFTER /drivers/{driver_id}, so FastAPI matched 'vehicle-types' as a driver_id parameter

bugs_fixed.issue: Layout page crashed with 'ReferenceError: Input is not defined'
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Input component was used in pending provider modal but not imported
